auth.heroTitle: Clear student insight for teachers and school leadership.
auth.heroBody: Sign in to access protected dashboards prepared for future Canvas, report file, and student information warehouse data.
auth.error: Unable to sign in with those credentials.
dashboard.title: Student data workspace
dashboard.description: Placeholder dashboard ready for future data warehouse metrics from Canvas, report files, and student information sources.
dashboard.blankBody: The application shell, authentication flow, protected routing, and API structure are ready for the next analytics modules.
syncHistory.title: Sync history
syncHistory.description: Placeholder monitoring area for future daily data workflows. This page will later track GitHub Actions jobs that extract Canvas LMS data through the Canvas API and load the MySQL data warehouse.
syncHistory.tableHint: No ETL jobs have been built yet. These rows reserve the structure for future workflow logs, status, and run details.
syncHistory.nextStepTitle: Daily Canvas extraction via GitHub Actions
syncHistory.nextStepBody: The future workflow should authenticate to Canvas LMS with a secured API token, extract course, enrollment, assignment, submission, and activity data on a daily schedule, then write normalized records into the MySQL warehouse for dashboard reporting.
syncHistory.metrics.canvas.label: Canvas API
syncHistory.metrics.canvas.hint: Credentials and endpoints to be configured
syncHistory.metrics.schedule.label: Daily schedule
syncHistory.metrics.warehouse.label: Warehouse load
syncHistory.rows.canvas.detail: Courses, enrollments, assignments, submissions, and activity data
syncHistory.rows.reportFiles.detail: Excel-based reporting data for future ingestion
syncHistory.rows.future.detail: Additional SIS or operational data sources
reports.title: Available reports
reports.description: Select a report to open a focused dashboard. These cards define the analytics areas that will be connected to the student data warehouse later.
reports.academic.title: Academic overview
reports.academic.description: High-level academic performance, trend, and intervention placeholders for school leadership.
reports.attendance.title: Attendance and engagement
reports.attendance.description: Attendance, participation, and engagement indicators prepared for future Canvas and SIS data.
reports.wellbeing.title: Student wellbeing
reports.wellbeing.description: A future dashboard for wellbeing signals, support needs, and pastoral follow-up.
reportDetail.emptyBody: This report page is ready for future charts, filters, cohorts, and data warehouse metrics.
academicReport.trendEmptyTitle: Academic performance charts will appear here
academicReport.trendEmptyBody: This area can later show assessment trends, subject comparisons, grade-level movement, and intervention impact.
attendanceReport.timelineEmptyBody: This dashboard can later show daily patterns, recurring absences, late arrivals, and Canvas participation signals.
wellbeingReport.mapEmptyBody: This report can later combine pastoral notes, support referrals, and follow-up activity for student wellbeing review.
accounts.title: Account management
accounts.description: Create, edit, delete, and assign roles for school analytics users.
accounts.formHint: Admins can manage profile fields, roles, and optional password resets.
accounts.accountsListHint: Manage access for teachers, principals, and administrators.
